title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
abstract: arXiv:2610.23009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). translated_title: “深度提升”：即使使用最“愚蠢”的优化器，神经网络也能实现泛化
translated_abstract: 给定一个带标签的数据集 $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$，考虑在一个宽度为 $W$、深度为 $D$、连续权重有界于 $[-M, M]$ 的 ReLU 网络架构中，从所有能够拟合（插值）该数据的参数向量中均匀随机地抽取一个参数向量 $\hat{\theta}$。我们研究当该数据集实际上可以由一个更小的 $w \times d$ ReLU 网络解释时，$\hat{\theta}$ 的泛化性质。尽管对 $\hat{\theta}$ 的选择规则是完全“盲目”的，它仍能以 $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$ 的速率自适应地泛化，而不受完整的 $W \times D$ 假设类 VC 维的支配。其原因在于 ReLU 网络中一种特殊的归纳偏置：$w \times d$ 的参数“见证”了指数级体积的 $W \times D$ 拟合参数，这使得（在拟合条件下）泛化能力差的参数体积相形见绌。我们显式地构造了这组近似等价的……
tldr: 该论文证明，即使以最“愚蠢”的方式——从过大的 ReLU 网络的拟合参数中均匀随机选取参数——只要数据可由更小的网络解释，所选参数仍能以 $\tilde O(wdWD/n)$ 的速率自适应泛化，其根源是 ReLU 网络的一种几何归纳偏置：小网络参数“见证”了指数级体积的等价大网络拟合参数，使其远超泛化差的参数体积。
en_tdlr: Even with the dumbest selection rule—uniformly random choice among interpolating parameters of an oversized ReLU network—neural networks adaptively generalize at rate $\tilde O(wdWD/n)$ when the data is explainable by a smaller network, owing to an inductive bias whereby small-network parameters witness an exponentially large volume of equivalent interpolating parameters that dwarfs poorly generalizing ones.
